description: Find Boston MBTA stops and stations — filter by route ID or by geographic coordinates + radius. Returns stop ID, name, latitude/longitude, municipality, vehicle type, platform info, and wheelchair boarding status. Stop IDs returned here are used as filter inputs for mbta-transit.alerts and mbta-transit.predictions. Use location_type=1 to return only major stations (parent stops); location_type=0 for individual platforms. Example: route="Red" returns all 22 Red Line stops from Alewife to Braintree/Ashmont. MassDOT Open Data License, no upstream cost.

latitude.description: Center latitude for proximity search. Must be paired with longitude and radius (e.g. 42.3601 for Boston)

limit.description: Maximum number of stops to return (default 25, max 100)

location_type.description: Filter by location type: 0=individual stop/platform, 1=station (parent), 2=station entrance/exit

longitude.description: Center longitude for proximity search. Must be paired with latitude and radius (e.g. -71.0589 for Boston)

radius.description: Search radius in degrees around lat/lon (approx 0.01° ≈ 1 km). Use with latitude+longitude.

route.description: Filter stops by route ID (e.g. "Red" for Red Line, "1" for Route 1 bus, "CR-Fairmount" for commuter rail). Use mbta-transit.routes to get route IDs.

name: mbta.transit.stops

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: MBTA Stops & Stations
